description: This Java source file defines the class GeoLocationImpl, which implements the GeoLocation interface. It provides functionality to fetch geographical address details based on an IP address, using MaxMind's GeoIP2 database.

classes.name: GeoLocationImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the GeoLocation interface that retrieves geolocation data for a given IP address using MaxMind's GeoIP2 database.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the geographical address associated with the provided IP address, returning an Address object with country, postal code, zone, and city information.
